row.proto: void Ui_Text_Commit_LineAligned(void *text_elem, float *line, float *cursor, float max_width, void *state)
row.notes: Finishes one layout line: increments line counter state+0x40, applies shrink-to-fit scale to line+0x10 when cursor[8] > max_width (mode cursor[2] 1/3 = x only, 2 = uniform), computes x offset from alignment cursor[1] (1 center, 2 right, 3 justify by spreading the gap over runs), advances the pen in state+0x20, pushes the line to text_elem+0x2f8 and resets line and cursor. Honors the visible line window text_elem+0x1fa/+0x1fb when flag +0x1f8 bit 0x40 is set.
